Action: Markus (Legal) — can you review the attached ClearPath MSA and the attached Redwood Order Form template and propose initial redlines / non-starters?

Quick intake notes for the review:
- Commercial scope: pilot only (1 host, up to 50k tokens/day) — pricing TBD in Order Form.
- Risk items to prioritize: liability cap, data residency and encryption, indemnity carve-outs, termination for convenience, security addendum (SOC2/SecReview).
- We should confirm whether ClearPath requires any change to our audit logs/data retention terms.

Attachments I’m sending: Redwood_MSA_standard.pdf (our canonical MSA), OrderForm_Template_Redwood_v3.docx.

Timeline: procurement asked for initial redline back by Tuesday, 2026-02-10. If we can't meet that, flag asap. Happy to coordinate a 30-min call between Markus and Alex to walk the high-level items.

Thanks —

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA & Order Form — next steps

Irene / Monica — thanks for the heads up. I reviewed ClearPath_MSA_v1.pdf at a high level and noted several points that will likely come up in redlines:

1) Liability cap: ClearPath proposes a 3x fees / $5M cap. We should propose Redwood standard (1x fees / $1M) for pilot engagements; consider escalation path if they push.
2) Indemnity scope: narrow indemnity; omit third-party claims for model outputs unless explicit breach.
3) Data residency & encryption: need to confirm whether pilot requires EU-only processing. If so, we will route to private deployment options (Redwood Private).
4) Termination for convenience: try to limit to 30 days with pro rata refund for pre-paid credits.
5) Security evidence: ask them for SOC2 Type II report + recent pen test summary. Provide our security packet (SOC2 cert link) and an external contact for security intake.

I've attached an internal guidance note with which clauses to prioritize and suggested language snippets (MSA_Redline_Guidance.txt). I'll prepare redline edits in Word track changes for the MSA and a clean markup for the Order Form.

Request: Irene, please confirm if procurement will accept our standard standard-term exceptions (data processing addendum + security addendum). Also let me know preferred time windows for a 30-min sync with ClearPath legal — I have availability Tue 2/3 after 3pm PST.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com
Attachment: MSA_Redline_Guidance.txt (TXT, 4KB)
